soak up the sun: On weekends, many people go to the beach to relax and soak up the sun on the warm sand.
週末時，許多人到海灘放鬆，躺在溫暖的沙灘上曬太陽。
soak up knowledge: Young children are like sponges; they soak up knowledge quickly from everything they see and hear.
小孩子就像海綿一樣；他們從所見所聞中快速吸收知識。
soak up the atmosphere: We sat in a café in the old town for hours to soak up the atmosphere of the festival.
我們在老城區的咖啡館坐了好幾個小時，感受節慶的氣氛。
soak the beans: Before cooking red bean soup, Grandma always soaks the beans in water overnight so that they will become soft.
煮紅豆湯之前，奶奶總是把豆子泡在水裡一整夜，讓它們變軟。
be soaked to the skin: I forgot my umbrella, so I was soaked to the skin by the time I got home in the storm.
我忘了帶傘，所以在暴風雨中回到家時已經全身濕透。
soak the rich: Some voters support plans to soak the rich with higher taxes to pay for free health care for everyone.
有些選民支持向富人重稅的計畫，用來支付全民免費醫療。
prices soared: After the typhoon destroyed many farms, vegetable prices soared, and families had to spend much more on food.
颱風摧毀許多農場後，蔬菜價格飆升，家庭不得不花更多錢買食物。
soar to fame: With her amazing voice, she seems likely to soar to fame like an eagle flying high in the sky.
憑著她驚人的歌聲，她看來很可能像在高空翱翔的老鷹一樣一舉成名。
temperatures soared: Temperatures soared to 38 degrees Celsius this afternoon, so the school canceled all outdoor activities.
今天下午氣溫飆高到攝氏38度，所以學校取消了所有戶外活動。
spirits soared: Our spirits soared when the teacher announced that there would be no homework during the holiday.
當老師宣布假期沒有作業時，我們的情緒高漲。
the eagle soared: The eagle soared high above the mountains, moving its huge wings slowly in the clear blue sky.
老鷹在群山上空高高翱翔，在晴朗的藍天中緩緩拍動巨大的翅膀。
soaring costs: Because of soaring costs for rent and food, many young people find it hard to save money.
由於房租和食物飆升的成本，許多年輕人發現很難存錢。
sober up: He drank too much at the party, so his friends gave him coffee to help him sober up before going home.
他在派對上喝太多了，所以朋友們給他喝咖啡，幫他在回家前醒酒。
a sobering thought: It is a sobering thought that millions of children around the world still go to bed hungry every night.
全世界仍有數百萬兒童每晚餓著肚子上床，這是個發人深省的想法。
sober someone up: A cold shower and a cup of strong coffee should sober him up before the important meeting.
沖個冷水澡再喝杯濃咖啡，應該能在重要會議前讓他清醒。
a sober assessment: After the flood, the mayor gave a calm and sober assessment of the damage, without trying to hide the bad news.
水災過後，市長對損害做出冷靜的評估，沒有試圖隱瞞壞消息。
soften the blow: The company gave the workers who lost their jobs extra money to soften the blow.
公司給失業的員工額外的錢，以減輕打擊。
soften one's stance: After weeks of protests, the government finally softened its stance and agreed to talk with the students.
經過數週的抗議，政府終於軟化立場，同意與學生對話。
soften one's voice: When you talk to a frightened child, try to soften your voice and speak slowly and kindly.
和受驚嚇的孩子說話時，試著放柔聲音，慢慢地、親切地說。
soften up the enemy: Before the soldiers attacked, planes bombed the area for days to soften up the enemy.
在士兵進攻之前，飛機連續轟炸該地區好幾天以削弱敵人。
soften the impact: Wearing a helmet can soften the impact if you fall off your bike, so always wear one.
如果你從腳踏車上摔下來，戴安全帽可以緩和衝擊，所以一定要戴。
her expression softened: When her son said sorry and gave her a hug, her expression softened and she smiled again.
當她兒子道歉並給她一個擁抱時，她的表情變柔和，又笑了起來。
solve a problem: If you want to solve a problem in math, first read the question carefully and write down what you know.
如果你想解決數學問題，先仔細讀題，再寫下你知道的條件。
solve a mystery: The detective worked day and night to solve a mystery that had puzzled the police for ten years.
那位偵探日夜工作，要解開一個困擾警方十年的謎團。
solve a crime: Using fingerprints and camera videos, the police were able to solve a crime that happened last month.
警方利用指紋和監視器影片，破了上個月發生的案。
solve an equation: In today's math class, we learned how to solve an equation with two unknown numbers.
在今天的數學課上，我們學了如何解有兩個未知數的方程式。
solve the puzzle: My grandfather does the crossword every morning and is very proud when he can solve the puzzle without any help.
我爺爺每天早上都玩填字遊戲，當他不靠任何幫助就解謎成功時非常得意。
sound the alarm: When the guard saw smoke coming from the kitchen, he quickly sounded the alarm so everyone could leave.
警衛看到廚房冒煙時，立刻發出警報，讓大家都能離開。
sound out opinions: Before making the new school rules, the principal wanted to sound out opinions from students and parents.
在制定新校規之前，校長想先向學生和家長探詢意見。
sound like: That sounds like a great idea; let's go hiking this Saturday if the weather is nice.
那聽起來像是個好主意；如果天氣好，我們這星期六就去健行吧。
sound a warning: Doctors want to sound a warning that sitting all day in front of screens can harm young people's health.
醫生想提出警告：整天坐在螢幕前會危害年輕人的健康。
sound off about: My uncle loves to sound off about politics at dinner, and nobody else can say a word.
我叔叔喜歡在晚餐時對政治大發議論，其他人都插不上話。
safe and sound: After being lost in the mountains for two days, the hikers were found safe and sound by the rescue team.
在山中迷路兩天後，登山客被搜救隊找到時安然無恙。
